rules.title: Security deposit capped at one month's rent (AB 12)
rules.requirement: Starting July 1, 2024, most landlords may charge a security deposit of no more than one month's rent, whether the unit is furnished or unfurnished. Last month's rent counts toward the deposit; first month's rent does not.
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential rental units in California, furnished or unfurnished, for deposits charged on or after July 1, 2024.
rules.exemptions: Landlords who own only two rental properties with no more than four residential units total, held by a natural person, family trust, or LLC whose members are all natural persons, may charge up to two months' rent.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Small-landlord exception depends on the owner's total holdings (two properties, four units total) and ownership form.

rules.quoted_span: Starting July 1, 2024, many landlords may only charge one month's rent for unfurnished and furnished units
rules.conflict_note: Document names AB 12 but gives no code section.

rules.title: Small landlord exception: up to two months' rent deposit
rules.requirement: Landlords who own only two rental properties with no more than four residential units total may charge up to two months' rent as a security deposit. Ownership must be held by a natural person, family trust, or LLC whose members are all natural persons.
rules.coverage_conditions: Owners holding only two rental properties with no more than four residential units total, owned by a natural person, family trust, or LLC with all natural-person members.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: The four-unit limit is a total across the owner's holdings (max two properties), not a per-building count; ownership form must be verified.

rules.quoted_span: Starting July 1, 2024, landlords who own only two rental properties with no more than four residential units total can charge up to two months' rent for furnished and unfurnished units if ownership is held by a natural person, family trust, or limited liability company (LLC) where all members are natural persons

rules.title: Landlord must photograph unit at start of tenancy
rules.requirement: For tenancies beginning on or after July 1, 2025, the landlord must photograph the unit immediately before or at the start of the tenancy to document its condition.
rules.coverage_conditions: California residential tenancies beginning on or after July 1, 2025.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only to tenancies beginning on or after July 1, 2025.

rules.citation: California state law (security deposit statute, as summarized by Berkeley Rent Board)
rules.quoted_span: For tenancies that begin on or after July 1, 2025, a landlord must photograph the unit immediately before or at the start of a new tenancy to document the condition of the unit.

rules.title: Pre-move-out walk-through inspection must be offered
rules.requirement: Landlords must offer the tenant a walk-through inspection during the last two weeks of the tenancy. This lets the tenant fix repair or cleaning issues and avoid deposit deductions.
rules.citation: California state law (security deposit statute, as summarized by Berkeley Rent Board)
rules.quoted_span: Under state law, landlords must offer a walk-through inspection during the last two weeks of a tenancy to identify any items that need repair/cleaning.
rules.conflict_note: Document gives no statutory citation or effective date.

rules.title: Limits on security deposit deductions
rules.requirement: Deductions are limited to amounts reasonably necessary for rent default, tenant-caused damage beyond normal wear and tear, cleaning back to move-in condition, and (if the lease allows) restoring personal property. Professional cleaning cannot be charged unless reasonably necessary to restore move-in condition.
rules.coverage_conditions: California residential tenancies. The cleaning deduction applies to tenancies beginning after January 1, 2003.
rules.citation: California state law (security deposit statute, as summarized by Berkeley Rent Board)
rules.quoted_span: The landlord cannot require a tenant to pay for, or assert a claim against the tenant or the security deposit for professional carpet cleaning or other professional cleaning services, unless reasonably necessary to return the premises to the condition it was in at the start of the tenancy, minus ordinary wear and tear.
rules.conflict_note: Document gives no statutory citation or effective date.

rules.title: 21-day deposit return with itemized statement and receipts
rules.requirement: The deposit, or any remaining portion, must be returned within 21 days after the tenant vacates. If deductions are made, the landlord must provide an itemized written statement with copies of bills, invoices, or receipts.
rules.citation: California state law (security deposit statute, as summarized by Berkeley Rent Board)
rules.quoted_span: If deductions were made, the landlord must give the tenant a written statement itemizing the amount of and and purpose for any security deposit deductions, accompanied by copies of documents showing charges incurred and deducted by the landlord to repair or clean the premises, including a copy of any bill, invoice, or receipt for materials or supplies deductions.

rules.title: Proof that deducted repairs were completed
rules.requirement: Starting January 1, 2025, landlords must provide proof that the repairs they charged against the deposit were actually completed.
rules.coverage_conditions: California residential tenancies where deductions are made for repairs.
rules.citation: California state law (security deposit statute, as summarized by Berkeley Rent Board)
rules.quoted_span: Starting January 1, 2025, landlords must provide proof that necessary repairs were completed.

rules.title: Move-out photographs before repairs or cleaning
rules.requirement: Starting April 1, 2025, landlords must photograph the unit after regaining possession and before any repairs or cleaning they plan to deduct. The photos and a written cost explanation must accompany the itemized statement.
rules.coverage_conditions: California residential tenancies where the landlord intends to deduct for repairs or cleaning.
rules.citation: California state law (security deposit statute, as summarized by Berkeley Rent Board)
rules.quoted_span: Starting April 1, 2025, landlords must take photographs of a unit after regaining possession, but before any repairs or cleaning for which the landlord intends to make a deduction from the security deposit.

rules.title: Annual interest on security deposits
rules.requirement: For units fully or partially covered by the Berkeley Rent Ordinance, landlords must pay tenants interest on their security deposit at the end of each year. A prorated amount is due if the tenant moves out mid-year.
rules.coverage_conditions: Tenancies in units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Requires the unit to be fully or partially covered by the Berkeley Rent Ordinance; coverage criteria are not stated in this document.

rules.quoted_span: For tenancies in units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance, landlords must pay tenants interest on their security deposit at the end of each year and a prorated amount if the tenant moves out before the end of the year.
rules.conflict_note: Interest rate and ordinance section are not given in this document.
